result.title: LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment
result.summary: Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LatLM：把文本置于二维格上，将「承诺调度」变为解码时的自适应选择——每轮给可扩展的 frontier token 打分，对高置信候选立即提交、对未就绪者延迟以换取更长上下文；并用 2D 因果掩码一次前向监督整条采样轨迹、以追加式缓存保留精确状态，在 482M 规模上与自回归基线对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本并行解码方法，但「延迟承诺」与逐轮置信度评分直接对应 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的提交时机与停止决策，二维掩码下的轨迹监督和 append-only 缓存可供核查 latent 状态更新与缓存结构问题；目前不涉及视觉证据或多模态输入。
